text:
maria: Heads-up: several new hires pinged that the orientation calendar event shows the wrong local time for them in APAC. Can someone look?

devin: Checking now. Event was created with UTC. We're running 10:00 PT tomorrow (America/Los_Angeles). Looks like some calendar clients aren't converting properly.

tom: For reference, in SG/HK that ends up as 01:00 local which is obviously wrong.

anya: I'll edit the event to set the timezone explicitly to America/Los_Angeles and re-attach a fresh ICS. Also will include explicit ISO start time in the description: 2026-07-12T10:00:00-07:00 (PT).

maria: Thanks. Can we also paste the Zoom link + passcode into the event body and add a fallback web link? Some mobile clients strip the query params.

devin: Agreed. Example we should paste:

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=redwood
Passcode: Rw2026!
Fallback: https://zoom.us/w/9876543210

anya: Done. New ICS uploaded and description updated with the Zoom snippet and the ISO start time. Also added: "If your calendar shows a different time, please join at the PT start time above or reach out here."

maria: Nice. Can onboarding-bot confirm recording policy and where we'll post the recording? Some hires can't make the live session.

onboarding-bot: Recording will be saved to s3://redwood-onboarding/recordings and a link posted in #new-hires within 30 minutes after the session. Retention for orientation recordings is 90 days.

tom: Could we pin the recording to the event after upload and include timestamped topics (e.g., 00:00 intro, 05:10 accounts, 22:45 security)? Saves people time.

anya: I'll add a short chapter list to the event description and will pin the recording link in the channel thread after upload.

maria: Perf. Also sending a short DM to APAC new hires with the PT time and a note to check device timezone settings, since company-wide calendar settings can be funky.

devin: Quick reminder for hosts: include the raw join URL on the first slide and in the chat so folks can paste it if their client drops params.

maria: Good call. Thanks everyone. If anyone still sees odd times after the change, ping me or @anya and we'll send one-off calendar invites. :thumbsup:
